symptom_short: Cluster non-DFS-used space is doubled after a dead datanode re-registers

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded; created PROGRESS.md and state.json.

Fix committed to trunk (c4a85c6) AND cherry-picked to branch-2.x. The doubling ONLY manifests on branch-2.7: there register()->addDatanode() does stats.add(d) with the STALE nonDfsUsed BEFORE updateHeartbeatState(EMPTY) clears it. Trunk/2.8/2.9 already reset before add, masking the bug (verified: trunk pre-fix reproduction shows correct 10000, no doubling). So the faithful pre-fix tree is branch-2.7: fix=f90b9d2 (also patches HeartbeatManager.register ordering), pre_fix=b516235. private/fix.diff is the 2.7 fix; fix.trunk.diff kept for reference.
Built hadoop-hdfs 2.7.4-SNAPSHOT -am from branch-2.7 pre-fix with JDK8+protobuf2.5.0 image. No pom edits needed (toolchain-only). hadoop-hdfs jar + all failure-path classes compiled.

Reproduced on branch-2.7 pre-fix via MiniDFSCluster driver. After dn1 marked dead (removeDeadDatanode->resetBlocks) and re-registered, cluster non-DFS-used = 15000 vs correct 10000 (dn1's 5000 double-counted, ratio 1.5). Test-only harness: SimulatedFSDataset emits nonzero deterministic non-DFS (upstream hardcodes 0L, vacuous) + TestReReg11896. Clean rebuild required to avoid stale cross-branch .class files (NoSuchFieldError LOG).

REDONE per operator's minimal-anonymization policy. source/ = the 9 REAL HDFS failure-path files (DatanodeDescriptor/HeartbeatManager/DatanodeManager/BlockManager/DatanodeStorageInfo/DatanodeStatistics/DatanodeInfo/StorageReport/FSNamesystem), identifiers KEPT. Only redactions: JIRA id scrubbed + metric nonDfsUsed->otherUsed. logs/symptom.log = the REAL M3 reproduction log (real registerDatanode/removeDeadDatanode NN lines) with the same redactions; shows cluster_otherUsed=15000 vs correct 10000. Regenerated deterministically by private/anonymize.sh. Verified zero bug-id and zero nonDfs* leakage.

REDONE. symptom.md = neutral HDFS description (other-used metric doubled after DataNode dead->re-register; no bug id). ground_truth.md names BOTH real sites: DatanodeDescriptor.resetBlocks() L313-319 omits setOtherUsed(0) [=setNonDfsUsed(0)], AND HeartbeatManager.register() L189-196 branch if(!d.isAlive) does addDatanode->stats.add (capacityUsedOther += getOtherUsed(), L409) BEFORE updateHeartbeatState(EMPTY) resets it. Verified zero bug-id/nonDfs leakage in source/+symptom.log+symptom.md.

5 independent runs via context/run_diagnosis.sh; egress iptables-locked to api.anthropic.com:443 (pinned IP), WebFetch/WebSearch disabled, OAuth creds mounted, IS_SANDBOX bypassPermissions. Single fixed prompt, no follow-ups.
